title: lavender beams, the snare strobes the drop
story: PinkPantheress's Stateside is a 2-step groove: the kick lands on the 2nd and 10th sixteenths (every 31 ticks), the snare on the 6th and 14th, hats too fast to carry. The build from 6 to 319 is thin: few lasers, brillo rising 0.3 to 0.7, and in the last two bars the strongest hits escalate the shake. The drop at 319 (+2.9 sd) relaunches the beams at a new angle with fat strokes for one beat and an opening contrast; the triple 479/486/494 rises in shake, thickness and flash. After it each kick thickens the beams, each snare strobes the brightness, the lavender tint steps every bar, and every two bars the lasers mirror.
